timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500 KRW per USD

WHY: The news indicates the won is currently weak, with the exchange rate in the 1,500 KRW/USD range and rising (up 1.80 won recently ahead of FOMC). Multiple sources suggest this high exchange rate may persist long-term, meaning you are paying more Korean won than usual to get your $2,000 monthly dollars.

TIP: Consider dollar-cost averaging or setting a limit order for when the rate dips below 1,500, since the current level appears elevated and may stay high; waiting for a stronger won would reduce your monthly KRW outlay.
